nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: Same saved data source, no new live research, usable materialized contacts, identical source/execution on retry, and explicit refusal for stale or absent sources.

nextAcceptanceChecks.steps: Sample current companies with exact or banded financial data, geography, sector and relevant missing fields. Review public sources and persisted quotes, scope, currency and dates. Separate genuinely unpublished facts from retrieval failures and work not attempted.
nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: Each requested field has a supported value, an honest not-disclosed result after adequate coverage, or an explicit operational gap. Independently review fit reasons.

nextAcceptanceChecks.title: People coverage and identity reconciliation
nextAcceptanceChecks.steps: For a small company sample reconcile found rows → unique identities → admitted profiles → saved contacts → useful role/channel data. Include empty results and partial pagination. Separate historical available contacts from new writes, and phone availability from paid unlocking.
nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: Per-company coverage and reasons, original observations, no fabricated personal email or role, no silent deletion, and a separately scoped paid-phone test only if requested.

nextAcceptanceChecks.title: One complete normal simulator canary per channel
nextAcceptanceChecks.steps: Use a fresh explicitly configured simulated account/person and the normal Acquire approval and dispatch path. Correlate original intent → submitted receipt → genuine model decision → normalized event/ACK → exact owned Acquire inbound → browser rendering. Treat local and hosted as separate acceptance scopes.
nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: One original outbound and its exact genuine reply per channel, correct conversation/account/owner and visible saved history. A provider-only pair is insufficient.

nextAcceptanceChecks.title: Recovery, replay, cross-channel stop and restart
nextAcceptanceChecks.steps: Inspect retained unknown originals through lookup-only recovery first. In a separate test scope exercise duplicates, changed payloads, lost acknowledgements, genuine inbound before due time, incorrect identity and a controlled restart. Preserve unknown holds and original bindings.
nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: Exactly one physical effect, original receipt retained, correct cross-channel stop, preserved history/holds, stale approval rejected and no foreign reply credited.

nextAcceptanceChecks.title: Real current campaign/n8n sequence lane
nextAcceptanceChecks.steps: Read actual active n8n workflows and runtime configuration first. Use a dedicated isolated campaign/n8n lane. Author, publish and enrol with exact versions/accounts, then exercise an actual HTTP lost response and a persisted wait across restart.
nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: Saved editor state, immutable version, one workflow/enrolment, app → n8n → simulator receipts, terminal callback and exactly-once wait resumption.

nextAcceptanceChecks.title: Native due events and actual cadence
nextAcceptanceChecks.steps: Use a dedicated silent persona and the current native worker with the browser closed. Observe due times, sending windows, timezone, replacement reminders, pause/resume and restart. Distinguish shortened fixtures from naturally elapsed default cadence; specify changed-policy retiming semantics first.
nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: Natural due-event pickup → fresh unapproved proposal → normal approval → original receipt. Stale events/approvals cannot act; manual due-time repair is not counted as natural timing.

nextAcceptanceChecks.title: Warm conversational follow-up and human handoff
nextAcceptanceChecks.steps: Obtain genuine inbound, approve an actual answer on its correct route/thread, wait the normal due boundary, then approve the follow-up. Separately observe a meeting-ready conversation reaching human handoff.
nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: Exact reply-parent/thread continuity, latest inbound answered, natural follow-up receipt, cold channels stopped and a human scheduling task. Do not claim automatic booking.

nextAcceptanceChecks.title: Release/runtime attestation before production acceptance
nextAcceptanceChecks.steps: Read deployed app/service/simulator revisions, mode flags, account bindings, n8n active executions and native worker heartbeat. Compare them with tested source/artifacts. Deployment and provider UAT are separate actions, not implied by this audit.
nextAcceptanceChecks.passEvidence: A dated inventory for the exact environment, with no assumption that main, a running container and a previously tested release are identical.

followUpVerification.scope: local isolated; separate from original read-only audit
